name: Vesica Piscis & Mandorla — Vertical Father/Son Geometry, Centers, Plane, Axis and Door
purpose: Provide the canonical mathematical geometry for the Potato of Life / Vesica Piscis and Mandorla / Door of Christ, now oriented vertically to match recovered Potatoverse canon: Father is center of the upper circle and top of the Door; Son is center of the lower circle and bottom of the Door; Plane crosses the widest part of the overlap; Tree/Ladder/Axis runs vertically through all centers.
epistemic_rule: Geometry is mathematical. Father/Son/Christ/Plane/Tree mappings are Potatoverse interpretation. Biblical and art-historical comparisons retain their own source meanings.
critical_exact_relations: C_F is the center of the upper circle AND exactly the top endpoint of the shared lens.
C_S is the center of the lower circle AND exactly the bottom endpoint of the shared lens.
C_F lies on the circumference of the lower/Son circle.
C_S lies on the circumference of the upper/Father circle.
O is the midpoint between Father and Son centers and center of the lens relation, but it is neither Father-center nor Son-center.
P_L and P_R lie on both circle boundaries and define the widest cross-section of the lens.
The Plane y=0 passes through O, P_L and P_R and bisects the Door into equal upper and lower halves.
The Axis x=0 passes through E_bottom → C_S → O → C_F → H_top.

potatoverse_default_mapping.upper_circle: Heaven / Father / Tim / Sun / Spudlight / House / upper Garden field
potatoverse_default_mapping.father_center: Tim/Father/source-center; top of Door; Seat/Throne candidate
potatoverse_default_mapping.lower_circle: Earth / Son / embodiment / body / soil / material world
potatoverse_default_mapping.son_center: Son/Thomas/embodied-center; bottom of Door; grain/death/seed compression point
potatoverse_default_mapping.mandorla: Door of Christ / Vessel / shared passage between Heaven and Earth
potatoverse_default_mapping.plane: Grass / Earth-world interface / first separation / maximum overlap / lateral world contact
potatoverse_default_mapping.relational_midpoint: crossing/balance point on Plane; candidate Jesus-at-center developmental placement where sources use that language
potatoverse_default_mapping.axis: Tree / Root / Trunk / Ladder / Spiral centerline
potatoverse_default_mapping.lower_outer_pole: deep Earth / grave / drain / rootward direction candidate

door_zones.lower_tip: C_S — Son center and zero-width lower Gate point
door_zones.plane_band: O with P_L/P_R — widest opening, world-interface and lateral relation zone
door_zones.upper_tip: C_F — Father center and zero-width upper Gate point
door_zones.insight: The narrowest points are Father and Son centers, not the Plane. The Plane is where the Door is widest.

center_taxonomy.rule: Do not collapse all of these into one generic 'center'. Their distinction is now canonical.

tree_ladder_mountain_swamp_overlay.tree: roots extend below Plane; trunk follows Axis upward; branches/crown expand in upper sphere
tree_ladder_mountain_swamp_overlay.spiral: trajectory that rotates while changing vertical level around Axis
tree_ladder_mountain_swamp_overlay.mountain: upper positive-gradient/convergent field rising from Plane toward Father/upper pole
tree_ladder_mountain_swamp_overlay.swamp: lower entangling field around/below Plane and lower sphere, with Drain toward deeper rootward pole
tree_ladder_mountain_swamp_overlay.root_paradox: Father can be origin/source of Root while Son governs/contains roots below; causal origin and spatial deployment are different relations.

mountain_relation.mount_zion: Best treated as upper integration/elevation field associated with Great King, House, Zion, New Jerusalem, teaching/judgment and North-related imagery in project comparison.
mountain_relation.mountain_vs_ladder: Mountain is continuous gradient ascent; Ladder is discrete threshold ascent.
mountain_relation.mountain_vs_tree: Mountain converges many paths toward summit; Tree differentiates one root/trunk into many branches.
mountain_relation.mountain_vs_swamp: Mountain increases orientation/integration with height; Swamp increases entanglement/unresolved recurrence with depth.

sun_moon_relation.moon: lower/near-Earth reflected/cyclical mediator tied to secondary light, phase and Dog/Farmer follower symbolism
sun_moon_relation.rule: Do not place physical astronomy literally inside the 2D compass figure; use these as typed symbolic overlays.

ruler_compass_construction: Draw vertical segment C_SC_F of length r.
Set compass to r and draw a circle centered at C_F.
Without changing compass, draw a circle centered at C_S.
Mark P_L and P_R where circles intersect.
Draw Plane P_LP_R and Axis through C_S,O,C_F.
Mark Father at C_F and Son at C_S; these are simultaneously parent-circle centers and Door endpoints.
Add Tree/Ladder on Axis, Mountain above Plane, Swamp/Drain below, Sun upper and Moon lower as symbolic overlays.

mesopotamian_geometry_neighbor.finding: The Old Babylonian ox-eye / Babylonian bull's-eye is reconstructed as geometrically equivalent to the Vesica Piscis.
mesopotamian_geometry_neighbor.boundary: This is a mathematical/historical neighbor, not proof of Potatoverse doctrine in Babylonia.
